notes.title: Angel Sex Pet OUT NOW!!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33669860/a148ff11d4080a8a4a86ed1a73ccbaffc6e8e1d0.png[/img]

It’s a Holiday miracle! We at Cherry Kiss Games are proud to announce a brand new release just in time for the festive time of the year! Angel Sex Pet is now live on Steam!

Experience this sweet angel with tons of features including:

[list]
[*] Translated version of the original Japanese Visual Novel
[*] Charlotte is fully voiced with original Japanese dialogue
[*] Original artwork HD upscaled with 16:9 and 4:3 variants
[*] Hours of story content
[*] Audio including music and special effects
[*] Enhanced with character sprite animations
[*] Gallery and Scene selections
[*] 9 scenes spent recharging your angelic sex pet!
[/list]

Get her blessing today and save 20% for the first week!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1474100/Angel_Sex_Pet/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1474100/Angel_Sex_Pet/[/url]
